change: Split the original/effective stop obligation from exporter-introduced adaptive samples.
measurement: svg.md:130-146 preserves original stops and names original offsets/order/discontinuities/alpha as mandatory; adaptive.md:60-76 calls literal adaptive count mechanical.
decision: A user-declared stop, including its language-resolved effective offset, order, coincidence, right-continuity, color and alpha, is morphology and must be preserved.
evidence_that_refutes: A ratified language source showing that one of those declared-stop properties is intentionally unobservable, or a valid witness preserving the language after changing it.

change: Remove equality of every adaptive offset/carrier from the public morphology gate.
measurement: svg.md:144-146 excludes exact stop count while requiring original offsets and error budget; adaptive.md:70-76 makes declared offsets/discontinuities/order/envelope observable and literal count mechanical.
decision: Adaptive samples are judged by monotone order within their source interval, support of the intended curve and sealed chromatic/alpha envelope; f32/f64 carrier, spelling and count are mechanical unless they change those observables.
evidence_that_refutes: A language-level discontinuity, original stop, curve-support point or envelope witness that changes solely because an adaptive offset moved while all v2 observables were claimed preserved.

change: Remove S20 from the blanket zero-positive-paint obligation.
measurement: p1266 matrix identifies S20 as zero-width stroke; typst-p1266-svg-generalization.md records stroke=8pt and positive painted area; p1266 raster gate preserved the vanilla-derived local morphology.
decision: A degenerate centerline with nonzero stroke must preserve its effectively painted region, role, graph closure and geometry; positive painted area is not itself a violation.
evidence_that_refutes: A ratified rendering witness proving S20 has no positive painted support, or an oracle showing candidate support/geometry outside the sealed vanilla envelope.

change: Retain the no-positive-paint rule only for fill with no geometric area and separate it from stroke.
measurement: p1266 matrix identifies S21 as zero-height fill; P1266 measured zero positive-area paint for all S21 pairs.
decision: A fill whose geometry has zero area must emit no positive-area paint while retaining a closed, geometrically correct graph.
evidence_that_refutes: A ratified language witness in which the same zero-area fill intentionally paints positive support, or evidence that the box is not actually zero-area.

change: Replace invented global cap <=64 with a bounded per-interval contract.
measurement: adaptive.md:53-67 and vanilla gradient.rs:905-965 set MAX_SUBDIVISIONS=64 inside one adjacent-stop interval; current adaptive.rs:115-164 repeats that bounded iterator per interval.
decision: Each strictly increasing original interval has depth <=6, <=64 segments, <=63 introduced stops and <=127 midpoint evaluations; zero-length intervals introduce none; for n original stops and p increasing intervals, emitted stops <= n+63p, p<=n-1.
evidence_that_refutes: Source or execution showing subdivisions above 64 in one interval, introduced stops above 63, midpoint evaluations above 127, aggregate output above n+63p, or nontermination.

change: Replace conjunction over the malformed clauses with conjunction over their corrected successors.
measurement: P1266's 74 failed conjunction cases all failed G04; 36 also failed the false global G10 and four also failed the unsplit G07.
decision: P1266 verdicts remain immutable; P1267 produces no candidate success. Only P1268 may seal v2 oracles/attacks and a later execution may adjudicate fixtures under the sealed conjunction.
evidence_that_refutes: Any P1267 artifact that rewrites a P1266 receipt, promotes a pair, or converts an old candidate result to Preserved.
